features.name: Multiband LED and filters
features.line: Light source: one multiband LED; each channel is one active band of a multiband excitation filter, imaged through the matching multiband emission filter.
features.seenInFiles: 1 of 1 .qptiff (Fusion 2.4.1): LampType XCiteMultiBandLed; DAPI and ATTO 550 through the DAPI / ATTO550 / AF750 set, FITC through FITC / Cy5.

features.name: Exposure per channel
features.line: Exposure: set per channel in Fusion and recorded per channel page; channels of one scan can differ by orders of magnitude.
features.seenInFiles: 1 of 1 .qptiff: Sony IMX421 camera, gain 1, 14 bit, no binning; exposure 1.5 ms (DAPI), 78.67 ms (FITC), 393.21 ms (ATTO 550).

features.name: Offset and shading correction
features.line: Processing 'OffsetAndShading': Fusion corrects camera offset and uneven field before writing, so an uneven field left in the image is not the raw illumination profile.
features.seenInFiles: Fusion 2.4.0/2.4.1 .qptiff: ImageProcessingApplied OffsetAndShading; Fusion 2.3.0 files record no ImageProcessingApplied. ScanSaturationProtectionType EnhancedDynamicRange on the 2.4.1 scan (what it does is not recorded in the file).

features.name: Whole-slide stitching
features.line: Tiles: the slide is imaged in camera fields and stitched into one image before it is written; seams can sit on field edges.
features.seenInFiles: 1 of 1 .qptiff: 106560 x 63360 px at 0.25 um from 1920 x 1440 camera fields.

features.name: Cycles
features.line: PhenoCycler cycles: each cycle images DAPI plus up to three markers (ATTO 550, Cy5/AF647, AF750 reporters); blank cycles image background only and are not in the image; the scanner subtracts autofluorescence before writing.
features.seenInFiles: 1 PhenoCycler run (Fusion 2.4.0, 2 marker cycles of 3, 2 blank cycles in its .xpd) and 4 more runs listed (Fusion 2.3.0, 2-3 marker cycles): every marker page AutofluorescenceSubtracted True; each cycle's pages share one write time.
